title: Training, Checkpoints, and Prediction
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of run.py workflow and county-year inference, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in crop-yield-prediction.
learning_objectives: Explain run.py workflow and county-year inference in plain language and connect it to run.py; cyp/models/base.py.
Trace one input through the training, checkpoints, and prediction stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the training, checkpoints, and prediction stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for run.py workflow and county-year inference.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
